Options:
  -r, --recursive  List recursively
  -l, --long  Include object size and time
  -a, --all-versions  Include noncurrent object versions
  --full  Show detailed object metadata
  --readable-sizes  Use human readable sizes
  --buckets  List matching buckets
  --format FORMAT  Set output format
  --project PROJECT  Select project
  --configuration NAME  Select a named configuration
  --account ACCOUNT  Select account
  --quiet  Disable interactive prompting
  --verbosity LEVEL  Set logging detail
